Inventory order and pending-delivery quantities no longer truncate decimals with parseInt; fractional cases or units can be entered and restored.
Schedule Builder exposes direct Create Template/Edit Template and Drag Board launcher controls so those real Copilot surfaces are reachable before the tools panel is already open.
Time Clock & Schedule includes Trade Board in the persistent subtab bar instead of only as a dashboard card.
Back Office nested navigation wraps instead of hiding QuickBooks off-canvas, and Prep keeps a clear accessible prep control name while retaining the visible Food Prep label.
